situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
Put focus on SL-111 and press Shift+X, so that all 7 cards of Ready are selected.
Click the label filter button "bug", then click "Clear filters".
question: How many cards are selected now?
answer: 2 ("2 selected"): SL-111 and SL-114. The cards hidden by the filter left the selection and do not come back when the filter is cleared.
